buyer_added_terms.text: OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Work The scope of work includes designing, fabrication, supply, installation and commissioning of customised un it flex boards at OP HILL Quarterguard Gate, OP HILL Mandir Gate and OP HILL Quarterguard Wall War. 2. Material and Quality All materials used shall be new, unused and of good commercial quality. The supporting frame shall be fabricated using suitable MS (Mild Steel) square pipes with proper welding a nd anti-rust treatment. Flex material shall be of good quality, suitable for backlit applications and outdoor use. Acrylic sheets shall be of suitable thickness, durable and of good quality. Digital printing shall be of high resolution with proper colour quality and finishing. 3. LED Lighting Arrangement Glow sign boards shall be provided with suitable LED lighting arrangements. LED lights shall provide uniform illumination throughout the board. All electrical wiring, connectors, switches and accessories shall be included in the quoted price. Proper insulation and safe electrical connections shall be ensured. 4. Design and Approval The design, layout, colour combination and content shall be approved by the buyer/user before fabrication . The successful bidder shall submit the proposed design for approval. No fabrication shall commence without approval of the final design. 5. Site Inspection and Installation The bidder shall visit the installation site, if required, to verify actual dimensions and site conditions before fabrication. Complete installation, mounting, fixing and finishing shall be the responsibility of the successful bidder. All necessary tools, equipment, labour and transportation shall be arranged by the bidder. The installation shall be completed as per the directions of the buyer/user. 06. General Conditions

The successful bidder shall be responsible for the safety of the materials and manpower during installation. The work shall be carried out without causing damage to existing structures. All debris and waste generated during installation shall be cleared by the supplier. The supplier shall ensure proper finishing and satisfactory functioning of all installed boards. .
